defect: clk_i is assigned two incompatible primary clock definitions
rationale: The design has one clk_i port, but the constraint file gives it two periods and names. Timing tools cannot use both as the single primary clock for the enable synchronizer and gated-clock relationship.

mutation.description: Added a second create_clock with a different period on the existing clk_i port.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the synchronized enable register, clock-gate expression, and gated-clock consumer; removed primitive instances and reset ports.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A second create_clock on clk_i (8ns, no -add) redefines the clock, conflicting with the 10ns one that feeds the gate.
